newsitem.title: USA: Madison Gas sees $20.2 mln in Q4 charges.
newsitem.headline: Madison Gas sees $20.2 mln in Q4 charges.

text.p: Madison Gas and Electric Co on Tuesday said it expected to post $20.2 million in one-time pre-tax charges and expenses.

The largest item is a $16 million charge for the restructuring of its gas-marketing activities. That provision also reflects the value of Madison's GLENCO and American Energy Management units, which have agreed to form a joint venture with another gas-marketing company.
Also, the company's expenses on maintenance and purchased power will have increased $1.5 million because of the extended outage of its Kewaunee nuclear power plant.
Finally, the company said it will return about $2.7 million to customers under a sharing agreement associated with GLENCO.
Shares of Madison Gas closed down 1/4 to 20-1/4 on the Nasdaq.
